meta.note: Visual identity for BetterMate — the web UI (Preact + Tailwind 4 + DaisyUI 5) and the 480 px round LVGL display of the GaggiMate-based espresso controller. Values are original to this system; the upstream DaisyUI themes (light, dark, coffee, nord) are superseded.

tokens.name: surface-0
tokens.usage: Page background. The darkest step in light, the deepest in dark; every other surface sits on it.

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, the sidebar and the display's status card. One tone step above surface-0 — that step IS the elevation; never add a shadow.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Tiles and controls inside a card: metric tiles, inputs, quick-select cards, the segmented mode switch. Two steps above the page.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and resting input borders. Decorative only (below 3:1) — never the sole indicator of a state.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that carry meaning: the secondary button outline, the selected quick-select card, a checked toggle track. Holds 3:1 on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on surface-0, surface-1 and surface-2 (15:1+ everywhere).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: card eyebrows, units, help text, inactive nav items — on any surface (5.5:1+ in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Disabled text, placeholder glyphs and decorative marks only — 3:1+ on every surface, so never for body copy.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The one accent. Primary button fill, active nav and tab, the selected segment of the mode switch, links, the focus ring, and the Pressure series. As text it reads 5.9:1+ on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of a primary fill.

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind primary text: the selected quick-select card, an info chip, a highlighted table row. primary on it reads 5.7:1 (light) / 4.6:1 (dark).

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a primary fill. White in light; ink-dark in dark, because the dark theme lightens primary.

tokens.name: heat
tokens.usage: Temperature and heating, as a MARK: the Temperature series line, the heating ring on the display, the heater-power meter. 3.3:1+ on every surface as a mark — as small text use heat-text.

tokens.name: heat-text
tokens.usage: Temperature and heating as TEXT: a live temperature reading, a HEATING chip label. 5:1+ on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: heat-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind heat-text: the HEATING chip, a boiler-temperature callout.

tokens.name: on-heat
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a heat fill — dark ink in both themes (4.7:1 light, 7.5:1 dark); never white.

tokens.name: flow
tokens.usage: Flow series (pump flow, puck flow) — line, marker and reading. 5.1:1+ as text on every surface.

tokens.name: flow-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind flow text (a flow chip on the profile card).

tokens.name: weight
tokens.usage: Weight and weight-flow series (scale) — line, marker and reading. 4.7:1+ as text on every surface.

tokens.name: weight-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind weight text (the dose / yield chips).

tokens.name: series-pressure
tokens.usage: Pressure series (current and target). An alias of primary: pressure is the quantity the machine is about, so it wears the brand hue.

tokens.name: series-temperature
tokens.usage: Temperature series (current and target). An alias of heat.

tokens.name: series-flow
tokens.usage: Flow series. An alias of flow.

tokens.name: series-weight
tokens.usage: Weight series. An alias of weight.

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Chart gridlines and axis rules. An alias of line — always decorative.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Ready and connected: the READY chip text, a connected-scale dot, a saved confirmation. Never the only signal — pair with a word or icon.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind success text.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Attention that is not an error: water low, scale disconnected, update available. Text and icon color; 4.9:1+ on every surface.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind warning text.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, destructive actions and the confirm state of a delete button (as fill with on-danger). 5.4:1+ as text on every surface.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind danger text.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a danger fill.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, offset 2px, on every surface. An alias of primary.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: The backdrop behind a modal or the mobile sidebar: 60 % ink over the page. No blur.

families.mono: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

groups.name: Interface
groups.note: Space Grotesk for everything a person reads: titles, labels, buttons, copy. Sentence case, except the two uppercase micro-styles (label, button).

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Card titles and the selected profile's name.

styles.name: subheading
styles.usage: Section headings inside a card; settings group titles.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Machine is ready, wake up to use.
styles.usage: Default copy, form labels, table cells, nav items (at 500).

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Help text, descriptions on profile cards, secondary rows.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form field labels and chip text (sentence case).

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Button labels: UPPERCASE, tracked +0.08em. Applies to every button size; icon-only buttons have no label.

groups.name: Data
groups.note: JetBrains Mono for every number that changes while you watch it, and for the uppercase eyebrow above it. Always tabular: digits never shift the layout.

styles.name: metric-xl
styles.usage: The hero reading of a screen: brew timer, live temperature on the dashboard's expanded tile.

styles.name: metric-lg
styles.usage: Large metric tiles; the shot summary cards.

styles.name: metric
styles.usage: Default metric tile value; the current value in a current/target pair.

styles.name: metric-sm
styles.usage: The target in a current/target pair; the values on quick-select chips.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Table numbers, axis ticks, tooltip values, log lines.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: The UPPERCASE label above a metric, chart or card (CardTitle). Mono so it lines up with the digits below it.

groups.name: Round display
groups.note: The 480 px circular LVGL screen, read from arm's length. Sizes are pixel sizes for the LVGL font converter (bpp 4, ASCII + °). Numbers use the mono face; words use the sans.

styles.name: screen-metric
styles.usage: The one hero reading per screen (temperature on Standby/Brew, timer while brewing).

styles.name: screen-metric-sm
styles.usage: Secondary readings in the top and bottom arcs of the screen.

styles.name: screen-title
styles.usage: The screen's name at the top; the selected profile name.

styles.name: screen-label
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrow above a reading; the clock on Standby.

spacing.note: A 4 px grid. Inside cards use 4/8/12/16; between cards 16 (mobile) or 24 (desktop); page gutters 16 (mobile) / 24 (desktop).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside a chip; the gap between segments of the mode switch.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between metric tiles and between chips; inner padding of a chip; the mode switch's inset.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding (small); vertical rhythm between a card's eyebrow and its value.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile; button horizontal padding (medium); gap between cards on mobile; page gutter on mobile.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop; button horizontal padding (large).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between cards on desktop; page gutter on desktop; section spacing inside Settings.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Space above a page title; between the sidebar logo and the first nav item.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: The inset of content from the round display's edge (its safe ring).

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Vertical rhythm between major page sections.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: The top and bottom inset of the round display's text zone.

radius.note: Containers are rounded, controls are pills. Nested containers step DOWN one radius so corners stay concentric (card 16 → tile 10 → chip 6); anything you press (buttons, the mode switch, toggles) is a pill.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, badges, tooltips, the value chips inside a quick-select card.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, selects, metric tiles, nav items, tabs' hover ground, quick-select cards — containers inside a card.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, modals, the profile chart frame.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: The largest containers only: the dashboard's main panel on desktop, the display's status card.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Every button (all sizes and variants), the mode switch and its segments, toggles, the display's arc-end caps.

shadow.note: There are no shadows. Depth is one tone step per layer (surface-0 → surface-1 → surface-2) plus a hairline where two equal surfaces meet.

tokens.name: shadow-none
tokens.usage: The only shadow value. Set on every DaisyUI card, dropdown and modal to remove the library defaults.

size.note: Control heights and fixed dimensions. Touch targets are 44 px minimum on the web and 56 px on the round display.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons and the +/- adjusters on a metric tile (desktop only).

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default button, input, select and the mode switch.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: The primary call-to-action at the bottom of a mobile screen; the sticky form footer's save button.

tokens.name: icon-1x
tokens.usage: Every icon at its native size — 1 px per grid unit: buttons, nav items, tabs, chips, inputs, the mode switch, the display's status row. This is the only web size.

tokens.name: icon-2x
tokens.usage: Icons at exactly 2× (2 px per unit): the display's action disc and mode picker, empty states.

tokens.name: icon-3x
tokens.usage: Icons at exactly 3× (3 px per unit): the display's wake-up and warning screens only. No other icon size exists — 12, 16, 20, 32, 36 or 40 px would split pixels.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: Desktop sidebar width (72px collapsed).

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Maximum width of the page content on very wide screens.

tokens.name: display
tokens.usage: Diameter of the round display (LVGL 480 × 480, circular).

tokens.name: display-content
tokens.usage: Diameter of the content circle on the display: everything but the gauge arcs stays inside it.

tokens.name: display-square
tokens.usage: The inscribed square where multi-line text is safe from the curved edge.

tokens.name: gauge-stroke
tokens.usage: Stroke of the display's arc gauges (pressure left, temperature right).

tokens.name: touch-min
tokens.usage: Minimum hit area of any web control; 56px on the display.

border.note: Borders are 1 px hairlines in line, or 2 px in line-strong / primary when they carry state.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers, resting inputs, the secondary button (in line-strong).

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: The focus ring (focus, offset 2px) and the selected quick-select card (primary).

tokens.name: disabled
tokens.usage: Whole-control opacity for a disabled button, tile or nav item; the text inside stays ink so it remains legible.
